chunks: And say during your tawaf: "O Allah, I ask You by Your Name through which one walks upon the surface of the water just as one walks by it upon the firm tracts of the earth. And I ask You by Your hidden, concealed Name with You. And I ask You by Your Greatest, Greatest, Greatest Name, which, when You are called by it, You answer, and when You are asked by it, You give, that You send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, and that You do for me such-and-such."
When you reach the Yemeni Corner, hold fast to it, kiss it, and send blessings upon the Prophet Muhammad and his family in every circuit.

key_terms.بِٱسْمِكَ: by Your Name; invoking Allah through His divine Name
key_terms.شَوْطٍ: a circuit; one complete round of tawaf
key_terms.ٱلرُّكْنَ ٱلْيَمَانِيَّ: the Yemeni Corner of the Ka'bah
key_terms.ٱلطَّوَافِ: the ritual circumambulation of the Ka'bah during hajj or 'umrah
key_terms.ٱللَّهُمَّ: O Allah; the opening address of supplication
key_terms.ٱلْأَعْظَمِ: the Greatest; referring to the supreme divine Name
key_terms.ٱلْمَخْزُونِ ٱلْمَكْنُونِ: hidden and concealed; describing a treasured divine Name

ai.seo_question: What supplication should be recited during tawaf and what should be done at the Yemeni Corner?
ai.summary: This passage teaches a supplication to be recited during tawaf, invoking Allah by His exalted and hidden Names and asking Him to send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad. It also instructs the pilgrim in the devotional practice of touching and kissing the Yemeni Corner and sending salawat in every circuit.
